step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a sub-block of a Sigma-Delta modulator, likely functioning as a bias network or a folded-cascode amplifier stage. It includes NMOS and PMOS current mirrors and cascode transistors to provide high output impedance and stable bias currents for the operational amplifiers.

Gain.description: AC voltage gain of the cascode stage from VBN to VGS2

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. Id ≈ 20uA, Vov ≈ 0.12V -> gm ≈ 333uS. With an ideal RL=100k, Gain = gm*RL ≈ 33 V/V = 30 dB. (A fully active load would yield ~60-90 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on SKY130 NMOS parameters and a 100kOhm test load.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the sub-circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: 3 active branches with ~20uA each. Total current ≈ 60uA. Power = 1.8V * 60uA = 108 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated from bias currents in the 3 branches under the forced DC bias conditions.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2*pi*RL*CL). With RL=100k and CL=1pF, BW ≈ 1.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance. Assumed 1pF for typical on-chip routing in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, and bandwidth of the cascode stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Bias Network / Cascode Stage
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xmbc=5u L_xmbc=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1c=5u L_xm1c=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm2c=5u L_xm2c=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM4 N5 N5 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N6 LABEL_NET_0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XMBC N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmbc} w={W_xmbc}
XM3 VBN N5 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1C VGS2 N3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1c} w={W_xm1c}
XM2 N7 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM2C N5 N3 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2c} w={W_xm2c}
XM1 N4 VBN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VVBN VBN 0 0.54 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VN3 N3 0 0.9
VN6 N6 0 0.9

* Load
RL VGS2 VDD 100k
CL VGS2 0 1p

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(VLABEL_NET_0)*0.9 - i(VLABEL_NET_1)*0.9 - i(VLABEL_NET_2)*0.9 - i(VN3)*0.9 - i(VN6)*0.9
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VGS2)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
let gain_db_3db = dc_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_db_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 1u
meas tran v_max max v(VGS2)
meas tran v_min min v(VGS2)

quit
.endc
.end
